Attendance

Month summary
Add staff member
Everyone you add appears in the Daily tab, where you mark Present, Absent, Half day or Leave.
💰
Salary
Staff salary
—
Salary of a month is paid in the following month (October salary is paid in November). Absent, half-day and leave days do not reduce salary. Payable = Monthly salary + Bonus − Other deduction. The advance is cut from salary only in a month where you tap “Not giving salary – cut it from advance”; otherwise the full salary is paid and the advance stays. If you give more than the salary (e.g. ₹50,000 on a ₹10,000 salary), the extra becomes advance. In a month you do not give salary, tap the cut button and that month's salary cancels the advance.
